title: Theo Launches AI Built TypeScript Compiler Without Reading Code
summary:
Developer Theo released tsc-rs, an open source tool that serves as a drop-in replacement for the standard compiler and type checker in the TypeScript ecosystem. The project was written entirely in Rust by artificial intelligence agents, and Theo stated he has not read a single line of the resulting code. He spent five months on the project, initially exhausting $400,000 in Codex tokens without success before completing the rewrite in two weeks using Claude Opus at a cost of $20,000.

The new release include an Effect plugin and features the gostd library ported into Rust by the AI agent. Theo noted the costs associated with Opus were equivalent to 10 weeks of usage on a $200 Claude subscription. The tool, which also includes a Language Server Protocol (LSP), is available now for developers to use in place of the traditional tsc compiler.

tsc-rs is an open source drop-in replacement for tsc, and it's available now.
